card.name: In or using after a motion verb
card.fires_on: The word "in" (sometimes "using") right after a verb of motion or action, such as turn, move, swirl, inject or decrease, where a manner phrase follows. Seen in instructions and dosing directions.

modes.label: Manner of a physical motion
modes.description: "in" after a handling verb, leading into a phrase like "a clockwise motion" or "the same plane".
modes.example: Once tight, continue turning the plunger<< in>> a clockwise motion until the stopper rotates

modes.label: Dose reduced in steps
modes.description: "in" after "decreasing the initial dosage", leading into "small amounts" or "small decrements".
modes.example: the proper maintenance dosage should be determined by decreasing the initial dosage<< in>> small amounts to the lowest dosage that maintains

modes.label: Using steady pressure
modes.description: "using" after a push or roll action, leading into a phrase about pressure.
modes.example: Push the syringe contents into the gastrostomy tube feeding port<< using>> steady pressure until empty.

card.writes: It nudges the model to continue with words like small, short and circles, which describe the manner or size of an action.
card.plain: It marks the little word that introduces how an action is done, such as in small steps or in a circular motion.
